data.name: Ledge Walker
data.description: This ability allows you to move along narrow, uneven or slippery surfaces (such as ice) at full speed using the Acrobatics skill without penalty. In addition, you are not flat-footed when using Acrobatics to move along such surfaces, and retain your Dexterity bonus to AC.
